objective: makespan = end_time of the last job on the machine

due_date.description: Hard deadline for the end of the job; empty = none
due_date.label: deadline

from_job.description: Job just finished, or start (empty machine)
from_job.label: previous job

setup_time.description: Changeover time before to_job when it directly follows from_job
setup_time.label: setup time

after.label: job that must start after it

decision_variables.follows[from_job, to_job]: binary, 1 if to_job runs directly after from_job (start/end = first/last job)
decision_variables.runs_before[job, other_job]: binary, 1 if job runs anywhere before other_job (job listed first in the job table)

constraints.one_next/one_before[job], first_job, las: every job has one successor and one predecessor in the sequence
constraints.sequence[job]: start_time >= end of the job it follows + setup time
constraints.handover*: time-flow arcs: carry the end of a job along the arc used, within its deadline
constraints.before[job, other_job]: big-M: a job sequenced earlier ends (plus least setup) before the other starts
constraints.head/tail[job]: start >= work sequenced before it; makespan >= end + work after it

follows.label: jobs run directly after another job

runs_before.label: job pairs where the first job runs earlier
